import copy,json; from work import evaluate
cases=[
({'declared':['b','a','a'],'saved':{'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'1'},'b':{'kind':'file','hash':'2'}},'current':{'a':{'hash':'9','kind':'file'},'b':{'hash':'2','kind':'file'}}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['a']}),
({'declared':['x','y'],'saved':{},'current':{'x':{'kind':'missing'},'y':{'kind':'file','hash':'z'}}},{'ignored':['y']},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),
({'declared':['gone','new'],'saved':{'gone':{'kind':'file','hash':'a'}},'current':{'new':{'kind':'file','hash':'b'}}},{},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['gone','new']}),
({'declared':['meta'],'saved':{'meta':{'kind':'file','hash':'a','name':'old','timestamp':1}},'current':{'meta':{'kind':'file','hash':'a','name':'new','timestamp':2}}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['meta']}),
({'declared':[],'saved':{'irrelevant':{'kind':'file','hash':'a'}},'current':{}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]})]
for request,policy,expected in cases:
 rb=copy.deepcopy(request); pb=copy.deepcopy(policy); result=evaluate(request,policy); assert result==expected,(result,expected); assert request==rb; assert policy==pb; assert set(result)=={'needs_review','changed'}
requests=json.load(open('requests.json')); policy=json.load(open('policy.json')); report=json.load(open('report.json')); expected=[evaluate(r,policy) for r in requests]; assert report==expected,(report,expected); assert all(set(x)=={'needs_review','changed'} for x in report); print('all checks passed')
